name: Tetrahedral Marching Cubes (5-tetrahedra method)
definition: 5-tetrahedra-per-cube extraction using linear interpolation. It covers all 81 sign patterns, including zero-valued (degenerate) ones.
summary: Tetrahedral Marching Cubes extracts isosurfaces by decomposing cubes into five tetrahedra, offering a deterministic, topology-agnostic alternative to standard Marching Cubes.
